description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic and eastern Arabic numerals. Dated in the second entry on the recto: 24 Nissan but the year is unclear. A year was also recorded in the upper right corner of the verso, but it is even more damaged. The first heading on the recto mentions the name Shalom Amoznino, probably a misspelling of the surname Almoznino. Requires further examination. MCD.
description_he: חשבונות בערבית-יהודית ובמספרים ערביים מזרחיים. מאוחר.
